title: The Amount a Resort Lodging Deposit Share Is Worked Out On
content:
Which amount the deposit share of a Resort Lodging reservation is worked out on turns on the published rate window the arrival date falls in.

Where the arrival date falls inside the unit type's published holiday window, the deposit share is worked out on the room rate standing on the folio for the whole stay together with the unit type's nightly resort charge for every night that room rate covers.

Where the arrival date falls inside the unit type's published peak window, the deposit share is worked out on the room rate standing on the folio for the whole stay.

Where the arrival date falls outside both of those published windows, the deposit share is worked out on the nightly average of the room rate standing on the folio multiplied by the fewest nights the unit type is let for outside both published windows.

## The windows the arrival date is read against

The holiday window runs from the 19th of December 2026 to the 2nd of January 2027 inclusive; the peak window runs from the 3rd of January 2027 to the 14th of March 2027 inclusive. It is the arrival date carried on the reservation that is read against them, and not any other night of the stay.

| Where the arrival date falls | The amount the share is worked out on |
| --- | --- |
| Inside the published holiday window | the room rate standing on the folio for the whole stay, together with the unit type's nightly resort charge for every night that room rate covers |
| Inside the published peak window | the room rate standing on the folio for the whole stay |
| Outside both published windows | the nightly average of the room rate standing on the folio, multiplied by the fewest nights the unit type is let for outside both published windows |

### The three tiers on hypothetical arrivals

A reservation arriving on the 27th of December 2026 arrives inside the holiday window. On a folio carrying 2000.00 USD of room rate over 5 nights, with the unit type's nightly resort charge taken here as 40.00 USD, the share is worked out on 2000.00 USD together with 40.00 USD for each of those 5 nights, which is 2200.00 USD.

A reservation arriving on the 20th of January 2027 arrives inside the peak window, so on the same folio the share is worked out on the 2000.00 USD of room rate standing for the whole stay.

A reservation arriving on the 2nd of April 2027 arrives outside both windows. The nightly average is 2000.00 USD divided by 5 nights, which is 400.00 USD, and where the fewest nights the unit type is let for outside both published windows is taken here as 3, the share is worked out on 1200.00 USD.
